canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Plains Commerce Bank denied {value} of its 3,650 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Plains Commerce Bank decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Plains Commerce Bank will deny any specific future application with 14.5% probability
Plains Commerce Bank is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Plains Commerce Bank discriminates or violates law
14.5% applies to Plains Commerce Bank's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
